# Panel (`panel`)

Titled tool panel and settings section, collapsible.

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createPanel` (types in `dist/web/layout/panel.d.ts`): `.mh-panel` (`--section`, `--collapsible`, `--flush`; `.is-collapsed`): a titled `section` with `__header` (`__heading` holding the `__title`, or a `__toggle` disclosure button with a `__chevron`; `__description`, `__actions`), a `__body` and an optional `__footer`.

```ts
export function createPanel(options: PanelOptions): PanelHandle;

export interface PanelOptions {
  title: string;
  /** A line under the title (a settings section's explanation). */
  description?: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Elements at the end of the header (icon buttons, a badge, a switch). */
  actions?: HTMLElement[];
  body?: Child | Child[];
  footer?: Child | Child[];
  /** Default `tool`. */
  variant?: PanelVariant;
  /** The title becomes a disclosure button that shows and hides the body. */
  collapsible?: boolean;
  /** Collapsible panels only: open at first (default true). */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Heading level of the title (default 3). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  /** Body without padding, for lists that run edge to edge. */
  flush?: boolean;
  onToggle?: (open: boolean) => void;
}

export interface PanelHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** The body element, to append content later. */
  body: HTMLDivElement;
  open(): boolean;
  setOpen(open: boolean): void;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
}
```

`createSwitch` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/switch.d.ts`): `.mh-switch` (`--row` for the settings toggle row): a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`, so Space toggles it and screen readers announce on/off. The track takes the control radius, so square corners give a square switch.

```ts
export function createSwitch(options: SwitchOptions): SwitchHandle;

export interface SwitchOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  /** A second line under the label (announced as the description). */
  description?: string;
  checked?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** The settings toggle row: label (and icon) at the start, the switch at the end, full width. */
  row?: boolean;
  /** A leading icon in the row. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  name?: string;
  onChange?: (checked: boolean, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface SwitchHandle {
  el: HTMLLabelElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  isChecked(): boolean;
  setChecked(checked: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createIconButton, createPanel, createSwitch } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const lights = [
  createSwitch({ label: 'Ceiling', row: true, checked: true }),
  createSwitch({ label: 'Floor lamp', row: true }),
];

const allOff = createButton({
  label: 'All off',
  variant: 'secondary',
  size: 'small',
  onClick: () => lights.forEach((light) => light.setChecked(false)),
});

const panel = createPanel({
  title: 'Lights',
  icon: 'lightbulb',
  description: 'Living room',
  actions: [createIconButton({ icon: 'more', label: 'Light options' }).el],
  body: lights.map((light) => light.el),
  footer: [allOff.el],
});

document.body.append(panel.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, IconButton, Panel, Switch } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function PanelExample() {
  const [ceiling, setCeiling] = useState(true);
  const [floorLamp, setFloorLamp] = useState(false);
  const allOff = () => {
    setCeiling(false);
    setFloorLamp(false);
  };
  return (
    <Panel
      title="Lights"
      icon="lightbulb"
      description={`${Number(ceiling) + Number(floorLamp)} of 2 on`}
      actions={<IconButton icon="more" label="Light options" />}
      footer={
        <Button variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={allOff}>
          All off
        </Button>
      }
    >
      <Switch label="Ceiling" row checked={ceiling} onChange={(e) => setCeiling(e.target.checked)} />
      <Switch label="Floor lamp" row checked={floorLamp} onChange={(e) => setFloorLamp(e.target.checked)} />
    </Panel>
  );
}
```
